cohort: 122 unvaccinated pregnant women with COVID-19 infection
finding: Severe COVID-19 infection in pregnant women was associated with an increased risk of urgent or emergent cesarean section, preterm birth, and neonatal respiratory distress syndrome.
mod_finding: Mild-severe COVID-19 symptoms influenced the mode of delivery, with a higher number of urgent or emergent cesarean sections than spontaneous or operative vaginal births.
